build_encoder_core: build a Transformer encoder using EncoderCore with config for self-attention layers and padding masks
build_decoder_core: build a Transformer decoder using DecoderCore with optional encoder output for cross-attention
create_multihead_attention: create a MultiHeadAttn module with CPE or standard self-attention and key-value caching for generation
create_feedforward_layer: create a Feedforward module with two linear layers, ReLU activation, and dropout for Transformer blocks
create_attention_mask: create an attention mask from padding masks using pad2attn_mask for self or cross-attention
